//: echojs-vs-node divergences the ejs lane FOUND and root-caused (2026-07-23,
echojs eir work tree, stage0 node-hosted compiler). Each is a pre-existing
echojs runtime/compiler bug verified by a minimal standalone probe — not a
maam machine bug (the concrete-vs-node lane is green on every one of these
files). Entries are structured (symptom + rootCause, both required — the
harness rejects malformed entries) so the record cannot rot into prose.
Gate semantics: a listed file that diverges reports KNOWN (non-failing); a
divergence NOT listed fails the gate; a listed file that stops diverging
fails the gate as STALE; a listed file that stops COMPILING (N/A) is
reported as unvalidatable — a warning, not a failure, because N/A means
the semantic claim cannot be tested in either direction (see harness).

arith-coercion.js.rootCause: `1 + null`: ejsval ToNumber(ejsval) at runtime/ejs-ops.c:260 is 'not implemented' and aborts. JS: null coerces to 0.

arith-intops.js.rootCause: `-8 >>> 28` is 0 under echojs, 15 under node — ToUint32 on a negative unsigned-shift operand is wrong/unimplemented.

arith-negzero.js.rootCause: `-0 === 0` is false under echojs (NaN-boxed bit comparison; strict equality must treat the zeros as equal). `1/-0` = -Infinity is correct, so it is the comparison, not -0 production.

compare-numbers.js.symptom: third comparison false instead of true
compare-numbers.js.rootCause: same as arith-negzero.js: the `-0 === 0` strict-equality bug.

math-statics.js.rootCause: echojs Math.round uses C round() semantics (half away from zero); JS rounds half toward +Infinity.

strings-number-render.js.symptom: Number("  7  ") slot reads NaN instead of 7
strings-number-render.js.rootCause: echojs ToNumber(string) does not trim whitespace; the spec requires it.

typeof-table.js.symptom: typeof null slot reads "null" instead of "object"
typeof-table.js.rootCause: echojs typeof returns "null" for null; the spec requires "object".
